youtube_best_seo_description:
Permission denied? Don't retype the command. Just type 'sudo !!' to run the previous command with elevated privileges.

⚡ Useful History Expansions:
- sudo !! : Run previous command with sudo
- !<prefix> : Run last command starting with prefix
- !* : Pass all arguments from previous command

The `!!` operator automatically repeats your entire last command with root privileges.
